post.description: Ability onboarding:create;60 requests/minute. Enabled by default, preserve existing network.cfg when cloud_domain omitted/null/blank. Explicit custom target requires validated public enrollment identifier (422 otherwise). New sessions may be explicitly administratively disabled (503). Source baseline must be available. Profile/target frozen; idempotency includes custom target.

post.description: configuration_sent captures server baseline after Internet returns. Repeating event does not reset baseline.

May omit body or send{}. Explicit verification-only recovery after the app already sent Wi-Fi. Preserves original identity/name/establishment/mode/class and acquires the MAC reservation again. An expired session becomes awaiting_online with a fresh current heartbeat baseline, timestamp and bounded verification deadline. Requires a later fresh matching heartbeat before complete. Live verification retries and completed sessions return unchanged; cancelled/failed sessions never revive. No firmware commands or credentials. Conflicts include onboarding_not_expired, onboarding_inactive, onboarding_in_progress, device_already_assigned and establishment_unavailable.

200.description: Same onboarding renewed for verification, or unchanged idempotent result

post.description: May omit body or send{}. Requires newer heartbeatCount, fresh server timestamp, exact identity and reported mode/class. Sets local name/assignment transactionally; repeat completion returns same result. Does not prove frame-perfect synchronization or physical name persistence.
May omit body or send{}. No physical rollback. Expired attempt remains expired; completed attempt cannot be cancelled.
